content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe offers a robust payment processing solution but only operates in 46 countries, excluding Nigeria. PayPal, while more widely recognized, can suspend accounts without recourse, potentially freezing funds for up to 180 days. Gumroad and similar platforms have restrictive policies that limit access based on geographic location. In contrast, COREMERCH provides a sovereign commerce infrastructure that is accessible regardless of where you are based. With solutions like the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack, creators can set up a fully operational storefront without dependence on traditional payment processors.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal explicitly exclude numerous countries, including Nigeria, due to regulatory hurdles and perceived risks. This exclusion forces creators to seek alternatives that may not offer the same level of functionality. For instance, while some platforms may claim to offer services in these regions, they often come with hidden fees, long approval processes, or restrictive terms. COREMERCH eliminates these barriers by providing a complete digital commerce stack that operates independent of these limitations, allowing creators to thrive without the fear of account suspension or unjust restrictions.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms often charge high transaction fees and impose delays in payment processing. PayPal can hold funds for extended periods, which is detrimental for creators relying on cash flow. In contrast, COREMERCH leverages NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which typically have a 0.5% fee and instant payment confirmation, ensuring that creators receive their funds immediately. Additionally, by using recommended networks like BSC and Solana, transaction costs can remain under $0.10, making it a cost-effective solution for creators in Nigeria and other restricted countries.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates dependency on restrictive platforms.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

One of the most significant trade-offs with traditional platforms is the lack of ownership over your data and infrastructure. When you use services like Stripe or PayPal, they retain control over your account and funds, which can lead to arbitrary suspensions. Conversely, COREMERCH gives you full ownership over your digital commerce setup. With automated payment processing and delivery solutions integrated into the sovereign stacks, creators can manage their sales and products autonomously, ensuring a seamless experience for both themselves and their customers.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators looking to quickly establish an online presence, the Sovereign Starter Stack offers a straightforward solution with essential features deployed in 48 hours. For those with more complex needs, the Edge Commerce Stack provides enhanced capabilities with additional product support and testing. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) combines all blueprints and templates, enabling creators to scale effectively. The choice is clear: adopting a sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only way to ensure long-term viability and flexibility in a landscape riddled with restrictions.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
